GRAMMAR JOURNEY · G3 / T1 / U06 · v1.0

Past progressive

答案與教學參考

開放題的示例並非唯一答案，請依判準給予回饋。

情境資料

先理解每張句子卡的意思，再比較標示的文法。這些是不同場合會使用的句子，不是連續對話。

昨日傍晚 I was reading at six yesterday.

確認昨天六點活動 Were you reading at six yesterday?

先備暖身

1. 修正 We playing now.

A. We are playing now.　B. We do playing now.　C. We is playing now.

答案：A. We are playing now.

複習 G3-U05：進行式需要 are。

2. 哪句是否定進行式？

A. He does not sleep.　B. He did not sleep.　C. He is not sleeping.

答案：C. He is not sleeping.

複習 G3-U05：is not 加 -ing 表示現在沒在做。

辨認與理解

1. 過去進行式的形式是？

A. was/were + V-ing　B. did + V-ing　C. was/were + 原形

答案：A. was/were + V-ing

was/were 與 -ing 一起描述當時正在。

2. I 在過去進行式搭配？

A. were　B. are　C. was

答案：C. was

I 搭配 was。

3. they 在過去進行式搭配？

A. is　B. were　C. was

答案：B. were

they 搭配 were。

情境與用法

4. 昨天六點正在讀書，選哪句？

A. I was reading at six yesterday.　B. I am reading at six yesterday.　C. I did reading at six yesterday.

答案：A. I was reading at six yesterday.

過去時刻用 was reading。

5. 問昨天中午是否吃飯，選哪句？

A. Did you eating at noon yesterday?　B. Was you eating at noon yesterday?　C. Were you eating at noon yesterday?

答案：C. Were you eating at noon yesterday?

you 搭配 were，移到前面。

6. 昨天八點他沒有在睡，選哪句？

A. He were not sleeping at eight yesterday.　B. He was not sleeping at eight yesterday.　C. He did not sleeping at eight yesterday.

答案：B. He was not sleeping at eight yesterday.

he 搭配 was not sleeping。

完成與修改

7. We ___ playing at five yesterday.

A. were　B. was　C. are

答案：A. were

過去時刻且主詞 we，用 were。

8. Mia was ___ at three yesterday. (draw)

A. drew　B. draw　C. drawing

答案：C. drawing

was 後用 -ing。

9. Was she reading? 她當時有。

A. Yes, she is.　B. Yes, she was.　C. Yes, she did.

答案：B. Yes, she was.

沿用過去 be 簡答。

改一改，自己寫一句

10. 修正這句，並口頭說明原因：They was reading.

They were reading.

they 搭配 were。

11. 用英文表達：他們昨天中午正在吃東西嗎？

Were they eating at noon yesterday?

參考句使用本課形式；其他意思相同、形式合宜的答案也可以。

12. 從自己的生活出發，用「過去進行式肯定：當時正在」寫一句新句子，可用虛構資料。

Mia was drawing at three yesterday.

示例只展示形式。換成自己的內容，確認句意完整且符合本課規則。

Writing · 昨天六點的定格畫面

用 4–5 句描述昨天六點不同人物正在做什麼，至少有一句否定。

At six yesterday, I was ____.
____ was / were ____.

參考作品

At six yesterday, I was reading. Mom was cooking. Dad was drawing. My friends were playing outside. I was not watching TV.

先檢查意思是否符合任務，再看目標形式。內容可不同於示例；拼字可查字典。G1 可先口述由成人記錄，G2/G3 逐步自行書寫。

  • □ 讀者能理解我想表達的人、事物或時間。
  • □ 過去進行式使用 was/were，並交代過去時刻。
  • □ 我的句首、專有名詞和 I 使用大寫。
  • □ 我檢查句尾標點，並讀出句子確認意思。

課末檢核

1. 修正 They was cooking.

A. They were cooking.　B. They did cooking.　C. They are cooked.

答案：A. They were cooking.

複數 they 的過去進行用 were。

2. 哪句描寫過去某刻正在進行？

A. We run every day.　B. We will run tomorrow.　C. We were running at seven yesterday.

答案：C. We were running at seven yesterday.

were running 配合過去時刻。

3. 將 You were sleeping. 改為問句。

A. Was you sleeping?　B. Were you sleeping?　C. Did you sleeping?

答案：B. Were you sleeping?

把 were 放在 you 前面。
